name: Create Basketball Playbook
description:
A high school basketball coach needs a digital playbook. Create a 3-page ActivInspire flipchart with the following content:

Page 1 — Court Layout: Title 'Half Court Setup'. Draw a large rectangle for the half-court, a smaller rectangle inside for the key (lane), and a circle for the hoop/free-throw area.

Page 2 — Starting Lineup: Title 'Offensive Starters'. Add 5 text labels for positions: PG, SG, SF, PF, C.

Page 3 — The Play: Title 'Pick and Roll'. Add text labels 'O1' (offense) and 'X1' (defense). Add a text label 'Screen'. Draw a line or arrow indicating movement between them.

Save the file as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/basketball_playbook.flipchart
